text.description_html:
30" Modern Appliance Handle

The Modern 18 Center to Center Appliance Pull is great for all the major appliances in your kitchen. Upgrade the handle on your refrigerator and while your at it change the pull on the oven to match. At 30 inches long overall, it is big enough to stand out even on the biggest brands of refrigerators. It is available in polished chrome for a sleek look, low maintenance satin nickel, and oil rubbed bronze to contrast with stainless steel appliances. It comes packaged as one pull with mounting hardware for a appliance door panel.

Also Available Matching 30" Ladder Door Pull.

Specifications and Features of the 30" Contemporary Refrigerator Pull:

  • Overall Length: 30"
  • Mounting Length: 18" Center to Center
  • Pull Diameter: 3/4" Round Tubing
  • Mounting Point Diameter: 27/32"
  • Overall Projection: 2-15/32"
  • Clearance: 1-1/32"
  • Comes packaged mounting screws for a refrigerator/appliance door panel.

Sold Individually (1 door pull handle).
